Amazon AWS achieved 0.12 L/kWh water usage efficiency in 2024, significantly outperforming industry average, and reached 75% progress toward its 2030 water-positive goal. Amazon and Microsoft announced a joint water replenishment project with NABU in Germany expected to return 750+ million liters annually.
AWS achieved a global data center WUE of 0.12 L/kWh in 2024 — seven times better than the industry average of 0.84 L/kWh — and reached 75% toward its water-positive-by-2030 goal in 2025, up from 53% in 2024. In September 2026, Amazon and Microsoft announced a joint water replenishment project with NABU in Germany, expected to return more than 750 million liters of water annually to secure long-term drinking water supply.

Germany's federal government adopted its National Data Center Strategy on 18 March 2026, formally elevating data centers to critical infrastructure and targeting a doubling of overall capacity plus a fourfold increase in AI and HPC capacity by 2030. The strategy emphasizes digital sovereignty, renewable energy, and integration of European hardware and software.
